title: The Poppy War
author: R. F. Kuang
summary: An orphaned peasant girl studies relentlessly to win a place at the empire's elite military academy. As an invasion looms, she discovers that her unusual power is tied to gods and may be a dangerous weapon.
readIf: you want a brutal, ambitious military fantasy inspired by 20th-century Chinese history.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic depictions of atrocities, as the later half of the book is very harrowing.

pairings.reason: Same author, another angry, thoughtful book about empire, though less bloody on the page.
Another grim fantasy that takes war and moral compromise seriously.
Another unsparing, brilliant fantasy about oppression and what survivors do with power.
